title: MEMS Vapor Cells-based Rydberg-atom Electrometry Toward Miniaturization
abstract: Demonstrates Rydberg-atom electrometry using MEMS-fabricated vapor cells. Addresses the challenge of miniaturizing vapor cell quantum sensors. MEMS fabrication for Rydberg sensors is more demanding than for atomic clocks due to higher temperature requirements and optical access needs. Shows path toward chip-scale Rydberg RF sensors.
key_claims: First demonstration of Rydberg electrometry with MEMS-fabricated vapor cells
MEMS Rydberg cells more demanding than clock cells due to temperature and optical access
Demonstrates path to chip-scale Rydberg RF sensor
Connects to Kitching NIST MEMS atomic device program
